notes.title: Maintenance Update Completed
notes.content:
Dear cave inhabitants,

The maintenance update that was previously accessible only via the beta branch is now available to all players. It mainly consists of small bug fixes accumulated over the last few years. We have also improved the anti-cheat system and removed the online-only constraint. The game can now be played offline on desktop, just like on all other devices (The Longing has been available on mobile and console for some time).

Thank you for your help with testing!
-Anselm

P.S. The original Shade plushie will have a re-run next month.

notes.title: Maintenance Update
notes.content:
Dear cave inhabitants,

it has been some time since we released a maintenance update, for testing is always a complicated affair with this game. There have been a lot of small bug fixes accumulated over the last years, especially since the game was released for mobile devices and we optimised it for touch input. We also improved the anti-cheat and got rid of the online-only constraint. Now the game is also playable without internet on desktop, as on all other devices. 

However since Steam is the biggest player base for the game, this update will not be set live immediately but first via a beta access. If you're reading this, you can join the beta by taking the following steps:

1. Right-click on the game in library view 
2. Choose Properties->Betas
3. Enter the secret code [b]CaveSweetCave[/b]
4. Press "Check Code" and then opt into the [b]longingupdate branch[/b]

This will give you access to the newest version of the game. It would be great if many people joined this beta, so we know if there are still things we want to fix. After we're sure that the changes in the update are sufficient, we will then release it to all players.

[b]Important:[/b] If you still run into bugs after downloading this update, please comment directly under this news post so we know they are related to the new version.

Thanks for your help!
-Anselm

notes.title: Full Steam Deck support and Polish translation
notes.content:
[h1]The Longing on Steam Deck![/h1]
Great news: The Longing is now fully compatible with the gamepad of the Steam Deck and all necessary adjustments for font readability and playability have been made. The game can also be played with touch.

Furthermore, a Polish translation was added to the game. Big thanks to the fans Jakub (OD-Jake), Michał and Filip who have invested a lot of time to make that happen!

notes.title: Game Update and Steam Trading Cards
notes.content:
It has been a while, since the Steam version of THE LONGING has received any updates. This was mainly due to the fact that the game was ported to other platforms, like the Nintendo Switch. When I first started making the game I used ancient technology like Unity 5, so our publisher ASH had the terrifying task to overhaul the game technically in many aspects, making it smoother to play and hopefully fit for the future on PC as well! To add something more fun to this update, I also decided to finally add trading cards, since they actually fit quite nicely with the waiting concept.

Here are all of the updates listed:

[list]
[*]  Controller support added. In case you always wanted to walk through caves with a joystick.
[*]  Small UI update for menues and the waypoint selection, since they didn't work with a controller before.
[*]  Japanese added as a new language. After all, we owe a lot to them.
[*]  1.5 GB reduction in file size due to better compression. This is also the main reason for the relatively big download size of the update, but it will actually save disk space on your machine.
[*]  Support of many different aspect ratios, like 4:3 or 16:10 and support of 4k full screen resolutions.
[*]  Steam Trading Cards, for the weary at heart.
[*]  Various bug fixes and probably new bugs as well.
[*]  Dreaming doesn't skip an extra hour any more to prevent lock-ins inside the hidden door.
[*]  Overall better performance.
[/list]

This update will not change your experience with the game in any significant way, but it will fix some technical issues and hopefully make for a pleasant addition in combination with the trading cards. 

So long!
Anselm

notes.title: Content Update and Soundtrack Release
notes.content:
Dear players,

I am quite impressed with the reception of the game so far. When I started it in my cave back in 2014, I made it just for myself. But it's quite heartwarming to see so many people enjoying the game for what it is. As a result, I got motivated to add some more stuff in, so I decided to work on some of the things I abandoned before release. You can consider these (early) [b]"Easter eggs"[/b].

With this update, which should download automatically, there are finally enough [b]books[/b] in the game to [b]fill the shelves entirely[/b]. They will appear throughout the caves after enough time has passed. Most are not that hard to find.

There are some new [b]items[/b] to put in your home: for example, you can learn to weave [b]carpets made out of moss[/b]. The other things will be left to you to find out.

Of course, the update also includes several bug fixes (and probably new bugs as well...). For example, the [b]flipping of crystals[/b] is finally saved correctly. Also achievements should now hopefully work on all Macs.

Regarding the translation of books, we are still working on a neat [b]Steam Workshop integration[/b], where you can download/upload translations or new texts in your native languages and replace the ones in the game with them. This should be done hopefully sometime this month.

Oh, and we have finally managed to [b]release the soundtrack[/b]! It features original tracks made by Lord Redstone for the game and various old tracks by other [b]dungeon synth[/b] artists, such as Vindkaldr, Erang, Spectral Kingdom, Erdstall and Dungeontroll:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275730/THE_LONGING__Soundtrack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275730/THE_LONGING__Soundtrack/[/url]

Greetings from isolation,
Anselm

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33396686/dd3b23c33fcdfbf9343debe7f1c1a2e6bcd01ecd.png[/img]

PS: If you have finished the game already and want to jump back in to find the easter-eggs, there is most likely a way to restore your old save. I will give instructions for this via email: anselm.pyta@studioseufz.com
